title: Decoding apathy in middle-aged and older adults: the indirect effect of loneliness and the moderating effect of cognitive function on resilience
core_idea: Investigate whether resilience influences multi-dimensional apathy indirectly via loneliness, and whether cognitive function moderates this indirect effect, using validated questionnaires and performance-based cognitive tests in a cohort of community-dwelling adults aged 50+ and analyzed with a moderated mediation model.
tldr: Examines whether resilience reduces apathy by lowering loneliness and whether that indirect pathway is moderated by cognitive function in adults aged 50 and older.
